Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 2
, Reason for Mistake: In the second step (the first Planner response after the initial WebSurfer search), the Planner incorrectly claims that the WebSurfer found "Pine Springs, Minnesota as an incorporated city in Washington County, MN". The actual WebSurfer result from the previous step only showed "Pine Springs, Texas" as an unincorporated community in Culberson County and mentioned "Pine Springs Preparatory Academy" in Holly Springs, NC. There was no mention of Minnesota or Washington County in the visible text or metadata provided by the WebSurfer. The Planner hallucinated this information, leading to an incorrect intermediate conclusion about the location before correcting itself in the subsequent step.
